categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled Tests; modifies test runner verification in src/test/script_assets_tests.cpp and tapscript test generation in test/functional/feature_taproot.py
categories.rationale: Tightens tapscript test vectors and enhances the script asset test runner to verify exact failure error codes rather than generic failure. The author discovered that prior tests allowed "a third-party implementation which executed OP_CHECKMULTISIG in tapscript and passed every case" because failure was inadvertently masked by DER signature errors rather than the tapscript opcode ban.
